column1: # THE ID IS THE `os-release` ID, lower-cased. THE ICON COLUMN IS `-` WHEN THE FAMILY SUPPLIES THE MARK. The exact
# twelve marks are the only non-`-` entries; everything else is here to give the resolver a family to fall back to,
# so a derivative that never ships its own icon still gets the right family mark instead of the hamburger.
# Linux families without an exact mark yet. They are listed so the fallback is a decision, not an accident.
